messages:
Jordan (Support): FYI AcmeCorp reporting a rollout stuck as 'In progress' -> rollout r-7123. Console shows spinner and no health updates for ~25m :warning:
Priya (SRE): @Jordan can you paste the minimal repro and any logs you have? I can check the status-sync worker and queues.
Jordan (Support): Repro steps:
1) Login to console -> Rollouts -> r-7123
2) See health chart stuck, last_heartbeat shows 2026-11-12T03:14:12Z
3) Click refresh, still stuck
Logs (trimmed):
```
2026-11-12T03:14:22Z status_sync ERROR fetch_latest_state r-7123 timeout=504 upstream=kv-store
2026-11-12T03:14:22Z status_sync WARN payload missing field 'progress'
2026-11-12T03:14:22Z status_sync ERROR unhandled KeyError 'last_update'
```
Jordan (Support): Customer is seeing API errors too when calling GET /rollouts/r-7123/status -> 500 with body "internal error". Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-12345
Marco (Eng): I looked at infra metrics — there's a spike in status_sync latency around that time and queue_len got to 312. Possible DB failover earlier. Not seeing a full panic in logs but the payload validation seems to choke when fields are absent.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: backend/status-sync v2.4.1 @ 1813457000 :robot_face:
Priya (SRE): I reproduced on staging: when the KV returns an empty list the UI health widget receives a payload missing `progress` and then the frontend shows an infinite spinner. Repro curl snippet:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" "https://internal-api.redwood/rollouts/r-7123/status" | jq .
# returns {"phase":"canary","targets":[],"last_heartbeat":null}
```
Priya (SRE): Workaround we gave Acme: call the internal resync endpoint (not public) to force a reconciliation. Example: `POST /internal/rollouts/r-7123/resync` (auth required).
Jordan (Support): Provided workaround steps to account team and asked them to run the resync. They confirmed it advanced the chart once, but then another rollout hit the same issue.
Marco (Eng): I'll ship a hotfix to make status-sync tolerant: if `progress` missing fallback to last_known_state and emit a metric. PR #479 open, will canary deploy ASAP.
Aisha (Product): Please tag me on the incident timeline. If this is >2 hours we need an account outreach and a scheduled update. @ops-bot start incident if we don't have a rollback/fix within 1h.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-88, priority=P2, owner=oncall-sre
Priya (SRE): Added a paged alert: status_sync 5xx count > 5/min for >2m and `payload_missing_progress` metric > 0. Also scheduled a short runbook note for Support.
Marco (Eng): Rolling the fix to canary now. Will post update when metrics show queue_len < 50 and `payload_missing_progress` = 0.
Jordan (Support): Thank you team — I'll keep the customer updated and paste timeline to CS-12345. :thumbsup:
